newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT- IBP Inc downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- IBP Inc downgraded to hold.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Monday it downgraded its recommendation on IBP Inc to hold from buy, citing expectations of reduced cattle supplies and therefore lower margins and earnings for the company.
-- Dain said reduced cattle supplies raises IBP's raw materials costs and lowers plant use, hurting its margins.
-- Dain also initiated a fiscal 1998 earnings estimate of $2.30 a share.
-- IBP processes and markets hogs and cattle and produces edible and inedible products.
-- Its shares were trading up 1/8 Monday at 23-1/8.
